
Rule Name:                            File and Printer Sharing (LLMNR-UDP-In)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Enabled:                              No
Direction:                            In
Profiles:                             Domain,Private,Public
Grouping:                             File and Printer Sharing
LocalIP:                              Any
RemoteIP:                             LocalSubnet
Protocol:                             UDP
LocalPort:                            5355
RemotePort:                           Any
Edge traversal:                       No
Action:                               Allow
Ok.
